algorithms.label: WEVA
algorithms.summary: Scores every request: velocity against the device's own baseline x endpoint weight x unresolved failures, across device, IP and account.

config.tuning: config/securityConfig.js and core/scorer.js defaults (recorded under environment.weva)

algorithms.label: Fixed window (strict)
algorithms.summary: 5 failed requests per IP per 15 minutes; successful requests are not counted.

algorithms.label: Fixed window (lenient)
algorithms.summary: 100 requests per IP per 15 minutes, counting every request - the package's own README example.

algorithms.label: Account lockout
algorithms.summary: 3 consecutive failed logins lock the account for 15 minutes; only sign-in is guarded.

scenarios.title: Paced brute force
scenarios.description: One bot, one device and one IP guesses a student's password every half second.

scenarios.title: Burst
scenarios.tests: Speed against the device's own baseline
scenarios.description: One device fires 10 guesses at the same instant, every 3 seconds.

scenarios.title: Rotating device ID
scenarios.description: One bot on one IP sends a brand-new device ID with every guess, every half second.

scenarios.title: Lockout as denial of service
scenarios.description: An attacker fails 3 times on a student's account from their own network; 30 s later the real student signs in from home with the right password.

scenarios.title: Stolen admin session
scenarios.description: A script holding a stolen admin token deletes student records 20 times a second, with a new device ID on every request.

scenarios.title: Campus behind one IP
scenarios.tests: False positives on a shared address
scenarios.description: Enrollment opens: students sign in over 5 minutes, all behind the campus NAT's single public IP; 1 in 10 mistypes their password once.

scenarios.title: Registrar posting grades
scenarios.tests: False positives on heavy, legitimate admin work
scenarios.description: A registrar saves 150 grades for three sections, one every 1-2 seconds.

scenarios.title: Low and slow, rotating IDs
scenarios.description: One bot on one IP guesses every 35 seconds for half an hour, with a new device ID each time - just outside WEVA's 30-second IP window.

definition.attackThrough: Attack requests that got through, summed over scenarios 1, 2, 3, 5, 8.
definition.legitRefused: Legitimate requests refused, summed over scenarios 4, 6, 7 (scenario 6 at 400 students).
